correctness.rationale: Each chosen world is a singleton in all r independent random partitions with probability q_n^r, q_n=B_(n-1)/B_n; inclusion-exclusion shows Pr(at least one)~n q_n^r since pair overlap is (B_(n-2)/B_n)^r and n^2 overlaps=o(n q_n^r) for fixed r>=2. Disconnection without a common singleton implies a cut A with 2<=|A|<=n/2 not crossed by any partition; for given k the probability is (B_k B_(n-k)/B_n)^r. Uniform cut bound splits at k=n^(1/3). Small cuts have total <=sum epsilon_n^k=O(epsilon_n^2)=o(nq_n^r), epsilon_n=O((log n)^r/n^(2(r-1)/3)); larger cuts have logarithmic bound exp(-(r-1+o(1))H_(n,k)) with H=log binom(n,k)>=k log2, hence total superpolynomially small. Multiple common singletons negligible and a disconnected remainder of at least two further components would create a counted nonsingleton cut. Standard Bell ratio asymptotics q_n~rho_n/n close the statement. An independent exact component-count recurrence matches enumeration for n<=5, r=2,3; this does not prove asymptotics.
residual_risks: r fixed >=2 is necessary to make the singleton obstruction rare; r=1 join is never universal except n=1.
The uniform medium-cut Bell ratio estimate is essential; finite enumeration alone would not establish it.

originality.rationale: Pittel 2000 addresses the exact same random join model and already proves high-probability connectivity with a weaker O((log n)^(r+1)/n^(r-1)) failure bound. The present leading equivalent is strictly sharper and supplies conditional failure geometry not implied by that bound. Bell et al provide general decomposable-structure recurrence but not an identified same mathematical model sharp rate. An older rare-component analysis remains a real priority risk.

value.rationale: The rate is a sharp first-order failure asymptotic and a conditional structural limit for a natural S5 random-frame model, improving the same mathematical model known O upper bound by an asymptotic logarithmic factor. It quantifies precisely when common knowledge becomes global and what rare obstructions look like.
residual_risks: Not a theorem about general intuitionistic birelational frames, arbitrary valuations, nonuniform sampling or r growing with n.

limitations: Sampling i.i.d. uniform equivalence relations for fixed r>=2 is essential; no generalized S5 or intuitionistic limit law.
